method: Institutional botanical descriptions and existing per-species reference notes guide organ shapes. No reference imagery is copied into textures. Deterministic geometry reuses pure mesh primitives and established shrub habit/count data; all build and palette functions are scene-independent.

texture_suggestions.153: orchid_sepal brown blotches; orchid_petal purple labellum veining
texture_suggestions.175: narrow pale stripe along leaf midrib
texture_suggestions.195: orchid_petal crimson speckling and pale margins
texture_suggestions.217: small dark spots on pale lower throat

geometry_validation.method: Pure Python Vector-compatible geometry audit; Blender export and in-game render verification belong to the integration pipeline.
geometry_validation.shrub_morphology_contracts: Viburnum21 heads, Hebe30 racemes, Pieris180 urns, Forsythia240 flowers, tea-tree160 flowers; wide Spirea/Hebe and narrow Boronia/tea-tree retained.
